descriptionZh: 使用摇酒壶进行短促而有力的摇晃，是含有果汁、乳制品或糖浆的酸型鸡尾酒的标准混合方式。
descriptionEn: A short, vigorous shake in a cocktail shaker, the standard mixing method for sours, fizzes, daiquiris and any drink with citrus, dairy or syrup.
stepsZh: 将所有液体原料加入摇酒壶的下半部（也称「壶身」）。
加入冰块至摇酒壶 2/3 处，使用方冰或大冰块均可。
盖上摇酒壶的滤盖与上盖，确保密封。
双手握紧壶身与上盖，以肩部为支点、肘部向上发力，水平摇晃 10-12 秒。
打开摇酒壶，使用 Hawthorne 滤网或细滤网将酒液滤入预冷过的酒杯。
stepsEn: Add all liquid ingredients to the larger half of the shaker (the tin).
Fill the shaker two-thirds with cubed ice.
Seal with the strainer lid and the small tin.
Hold the tins firmly and shake horizontally for 10-12 seconds, driving motion from the shoulders.
Strain through a Hawthorne strainer (and fine strainer if double-straining) into a chilled glass.
tipsZh: 摇酒时壶身贴近耳朵，听到冰块碎裂的清脆声即可停止——这是「冰听」的判断方式。
摇酒壶用前先在冷冻室冰 10 分钟，降温可让鸡尾酒更持久地保持冰凉。
tipsEn: Listen for the ice to crack — when you stop hearing sharp cracks, the drink is properly diluted and aerated.
Pre-chill the shaker in the freezer for 10 minutes for better thermal retention.
warningsZh: 使用大冰块时摇晃时间可适当延长 2-3 秒，避免稀释不足。
若壶身密封不严会导致液体喷溅。
warningsEn: With large ice cubes, extend the shake by 2-3 seconds to compensate for the slower dilution.
A loose seal will cause the shaker to spit when you shake.

descriptionZh: 先不加冰进行第一次摇和，让蛋清充分乳化，再加冰进行第二次摇和，是使用蛋清的鸡尾酒形成绵密泡沫的关键。
descriptionEn: A two-stage shake: first without ice to emulsify egg white, then with ice to chill and dilute. Essential for a proper foam cap on sours and fizzes.
stepsZh: 将除冰外的所有原料（含蛋清）加入摇酒壶壶身。
盖紧摇酒壶，不加冰进行第一次干摇 10-15 秒，让蛋清充分打发起泡。
打开摇酒壶，加入冰块至 2/3 处。
再次盖紧，进行第二次湿摇 10-12 秒，降温并适度稀释。
使用细滤网双重过滤入杯，泡沫会自然浮在酒面。
stepsEn: Add all ingredients including egg white to the shaker tin, no ice yet.
Seal and shake hard for 10-15 seconds — this is the dry shake, emulsifying the egg white.
Open, add cubed ice to two-thirds full.
Re-seal and perform a second wet shake for 10-12 seconds.
Double-strain into the glass; the foam will cap the drink naturally.
tipsZh: 干摇时间要够长，蛋清未充分打发会导致泡沫不绵密、消散过快。
可加入少量简单糖浆（1 tsp）帮助泡沫稳定，但更关键是干摇时间足够。
tipsEn: Under-shaking the dry phase leaves a thin foam that dissipates quickly — be patient and shake hard.
A small amount of simple syrup helps stabilise the foam, but timing matters more.
warningsZh: 蛋清未打发会出现泡沫不绵密、液面浑浊的问题。
若两次摇和顺序颠倒，无法形成稳定的绵密泡沫。
warningsEn: Under-emulsified egg white yields a thin, short-lived foam and a slightly cloudy body.
Reversing the order — wet first, dry after — defeats the purpose of aeration.

descriptionZh: 使用吧匙与搅拌杯进行温和的搅拌，是高酒精度、纯烈酒型鸡尾酒（Manhattan、Martini、Negroni）的标准方式。
descriptionEn: Gentle stirring with a bar spoon and mixing glass, the standard for spirit-forward drinks like Manhattan, Martini and Negroni.
stepsZh: 将所有液体原料加入预冷过的搅拌杯。
加入大量方冰与冰球（搅拌杯 2/3 满），保证降温与稀释。
插入吧匙，沿杯壁顺时针方向平稳搅动 30 圈左右（约 30 秒）。
使用 Hawthorne 滤网将酒液滤入预冷过的鸡尾酒杯。
用橙皮或柠檬皮在酒面轻拧喷香，作为装饰。
stepsEn: Add all liquid ingredients to a chilled mixing glass.
Fill the mixing glass two-thirds with cubed ice and a large mixing cube if available.
Insert a bar spoon and stir smoothly for about 30 rotations (~30 seconds).
Strain through a Hawthorne strainer into a chilled cocktail glass.
Express citrus oils over the surface and place the peel as garnish.
tipsZh: 搅和速度要稳，避免剧烈搅动引入过多气泡——搅拌型鸡尾酒追求澄澈。
吧匙沿杯壁转可以减少摩擦音和过度搅动。
tipsEn: Keep the motion smooth — vigorous stirring whips air into the drink and clouds the texture.
Run the spoon along the glass wall to reduce friction noise.
warningsZh: 搅拌不足会让鸡尾酒温度偏高、稀释不足，口感刺喉。
warningsEn: Under-stirring leaves the drink too warm and harsh; the surface should be visibly cold and slightly viscous.

descriptionZh: 在摇酒壶中以轻柔翻滚的方式混合，是不希望产生泡沫的蛋清酒（如 Hemingway Daiquiri）或浓稠酒体的混合方式。
descriptionEn: A gentle pour between tins without the agitation of a shake, used when you want dilution and chill without aeration.
stepsZh: 将所有液体原料加入摇酒壶壶身。
加入冰块至摇酒壶 2/3 处。
盖紧摇酒壶，从一手传递到另一手，让酒液在两半壶之间轻柔滚动 5-6 次。
打开摇酒壶，使用滤网将酒液滤入预冷过的酒杯。
stepsEn: Add all liquid ingredients to the shaker tin.
Fill the shaker two-thirds with cubed ice.
Seal and gently roll the liquid back and forth between the two tins 5-6 times.
Strain into a chilled glass.
tipsZh: 滚和不会产生泡沫，适合不希望形成蛋清泡沫的酸型鸡尾酒。
若想要更明显的稀释效果，可多滚 1-2 次。
tipsEn: Rolling keeps the drink clear of foam — perfect for an egg-white drink where you want a flat body, or for clearing texture.
Add a couple of extra rolls if you want slightly more dilution.

descriptionZh: 直接在酒杯中按顺序加入原料，是高球杯鸡尾酒（G&T、Mule、Spritz）的最简方式。
descriptionEn: Layering ingredients directly into the serving glass — the simplest method for highballs, mules and spritzes.
stepsZh: 根据配方在酒杯中预先加入冰块（方冰或冰球）。
先加入烈酒与利口酒等酒精原料。
再加入果汁、糖浆等调制原料。
最后加入汤力水、苏打水等碳酸饮料，倾斜杯身轻倒以保留气泡。
用吧匙从下往上轻搅 2-3 次即可饮用。
stepsEn: Pre-fill the serving glass with the appropriate ice.
Pour all spirit and liqueur ingredients over the ice.
Add juices and syrups next.
Top with tonic, soda or ginger beer, pouring down a bar spoon to preserve carbonation.
Give the drink one or two gentle stirs from the bottom up.
tipsZh: 碳酸饮料最后加且沿吧匙或杯壁倒入，可最大程度保留气泡。
杯身预冷可以延缓冰块融化。
tipsEn: Always add carbonated mixers last, pouring down a bar spoon to preserve fizz.
Chill the serving glass in advance to slow dilution.
warningsZh: 剧烈搅拌会导致碳酸饮料快速跑气。
warningsEn: Vigorous stirring knocks the carbonation out of a highball.

descriptionZh: 使用木质或不锈钢捣棒在摇酒壶或搅拌杯中按压香草、果实等原料，萃取风味与精油。
descriptionEn: Pressing herbs, fruit or sugar with a muddler to release essential oils and juice before shaking or stirring.
stepsZh: 将薄荷、罗勒等香草与糖或糖浆一起放入摇酒壶底部。
使用木质捣棒的钝端，垂直向下轻压 3-4 次，力度约为捣棒自重的轻压。
对青柠角等果实原料，以同样的方式压榨出汁。
加入其余液体原料与冰块，按配方进行摇和或搅拌。
stepsEn: Place herbs and sugar (or syrup) at the bottom of the shaker tin.
Press gently with the flat end of a wooden muddler 3-4 times, using just the weight of the muddler.
For lime wedges or fruit, muddle to express the juice without pulverising the peel.
Add remaining liquid and ice, then shake or stir per the recipe.
tipsZh: 薄荷只要轻压——过度捣压会释放叶绿素，让酒液发苦变黑。
糖作为磨料有助于香草精油的释放，因此 Mojito 等配方常把糖与薄荷一起捣压。
tipsEn: Be gentle with herbs — over-muddling mint releases chlorophyll and turns the drink bitter and black.
Sugar acts as an abrasive that helps release mint oils, so Mojito benefits from a sugar-and-mint muddle.
warningsZh: 薄荷捣压过狠会导致苦味与青草味过重。
苦精或香料过度捣压会释放单宁，让酒液发涩。
warningsEn: Heavy-handed muddling of mint gives an intensely bitter, grassy drink.
Over-muddling bitters or spices releases harsh tannins.

descriptionZh: 使用 Hawthorne 滤网与细滤网（茶滤/中式漏勺）双重过滤，去除冰渣与固体颗粒，让鸡尾酒液面澄澈。
descriptionEn: Using both a Hawthorne strainer and a fine mesh strainer to remove ice chips and pulp for a crystal-clear cocktail.
stepsZh: 将摇酒壶上的 Hawthorne 滤网对准鸡尾酒杯的杯口。
在滤网下方再加一只细滤网（茶滤/中式漏勺）。
缓慢倾倒酒液，让细滤网截留冰渣、果肉、薄荷叶碎等。
倾倒完毕后取下细滤网，完成双重过滤。
stepsEn: Hold the Hawthorne strainer on top of the shaker tin.
Hold a fine-mesh strainer over the serving glass.
Pour slowly so the fine strainer catches ice chips, pulp and herb fragments.
Discard the contents of the fine strainer and serve immediately.
tipsZh: 使用蛋清的鸡尾酒几乎一定要双重过滤，避免蛋清液面出现冰渣。
细滤网要保持干燥，否则会粘附酒液导致浪费。
tipsEn: Any drink with egg white, muddled fruit or fine herbs should be double-strained.
Keep the fine strainer dry — a wet mesh catches too much liquid and slows the pour.

descriptionZh: 利用牛奶中的酪蛋白在酸性环境下凝固，吸附并去除酒液中的杂质与不良风味，是传统澄清鸡尾酒的方式。
descriptionEn: Curdling milk proteins in an acidic cocktail to capture impurities, then filtering for a silky, clarified drink.
stepsZh: 将所有原料与全脂牛奶（按体积 1:1）一起放入大玻璃罐中混合均匀。
加入适量柠檬汁或醋（约 1-2 tsp），让牛奶中的酪蛋白凝固。
用保鲜膜封口，置于冰箱冷藏 12-24 小时。
凝固物沉底后，使用咖啡滤纸或细滤布将上层澄清酒液缓缓过滤。
所得澄清酒液即可用于装杯。
stepsEn: Combine the cocktail base with whole milk at roughly 1:1 by volume in a large jar.
Add a small amount of citrus juice or vinegar (1-2 tsp) to curdle the milk proteins.
Seal and refrigerate 12-24 hours.
Once the curds have settled, strain through a coffee filter or cheesecloth to collect the clear liquid.
The clarified cocktail is ready to serve.
tipsZh: 使用全脂牛奶效果最好，脱脂奶酪蛋白含量低、澄清效果差。
过滤时不要按压凝固物，否则会让浑浊颗粒重新进入酒液。
tipsEn: Whole milk works best — skim milk has too few proteins to form a strong curd.
Resist pressing the curds during filtration; gravity alone gives a clearer result.
warningsZh: 需使用新鲜牛奶并冷藏操作，否则有食品安全风险。
咖啡滤纸过滤速度慢，要预留充足时间。
warningsEn: Always use fresh, refrigerated milk and keep the wash cold to stay food-safe.
Coffee-filter straining is slow — budget at least 1-2 hours per batch.

descriptionZh: 让基酒与少量风味油脂（如橄榄油、芝麻油、花生油）充分融合后冷冻，使油脂凝固并被滤除，留下独特的风味酒。
descriptionEn: Infusing a spirit with a flavourful oil, freezing to solidify the oil, then filtering it out to leave a perfumed, fat-free base.
stepsZh: 将基酒与少量冷压风味油（约 1-2 oz 油/750ml 酒）放入密封玻璃罐。
室温静置 4-6 小时，让油脂风味充分融合到酒中。
将玻璃罐放入冷冻室冷冻 4-6 小时，让油脂完全凝固。
取出后立即使用咖啡滤纸或细滤布过滤，去除凝固油脂。
所得澄清酒液即可用于配方。
stepsEn: Combine the base spirit with a small amount of flavour oil (1-2 oz per 750ml) in a sealed jar.
Rest at room temperature 4-6 hours to infuse.
Transfer to the freezer for 4-6 hours until the oil fully solidifies.
Quickly filter through a coffee filter or cheesecloth to remove the solid oil.
The clarified, oil-infused spirit is ready to use in the recipe.
tipsZh: 油洗后的基酒可用于 Martini 等搅拌型鸡尾酒，赋予微妙油脂香。
选择风味强烈且稳定的油脂，如冷压橄榄油、烤芝麻油。
tipsEn: An oil-washed gin is a luxurious base for a dirty-style martini.
Choose a strongly flavoured, stable oil — extra-virgin olive, toasted sesame, or peanut.
warningsZh: 未完全冷冻的油脂会残留酒中导致液面油花。
油脂选择不当会让酒液产生不悦的油耗味。
warningsEn: If the oil is not fully frozen, residual fat will float on the final spirit.
Use a fresh, high-quality oil — rancid oils ruin the whole batch.

descriptionZh: 使用融化黄油、培根油脂等动物脂肪浸泡基酒，赋予酒液培根烟熏或黄油饼干风味，是现代鸡尾酒的常用技巧。
descriptionEn: Infusing a spirit with melted butter, bacon fat or other animal fats to create a savoury, bacon- or butter-forward base.
stepsZh: 将选定的脂肪（如培根油脂或无盐黄油）低温融化至液态。
将液态脂肪与基酒按约 1:4 至 1:8 比例倒入密封玻璃罐。
室温或 50°C 水浴浸泡 2-4 小时，让脂肪风味进入酒液。
放入冷冻室冷冻 4-6 小时，让脂肪完全凝固上浮。
取出后立即用咖啡滤纸过滤，去除凝固脂肪层。
stepsEn: Melt the chosen fat (e.g. rendered bacon fat or unsalted butter) to a liquid.
Combine with the base spirit in a sealed jar at roughly 1:4 to 1:8 fat to spirit.
Infuse 2-4 hours at room temperature or in a 50°C water bath.
Freeze 4-6 hours until the fat has fully solidified.
Filter immediately through a coffee filter to remove the solid fat layer.
tipsZh: 培根油洗波本搭配 Maple 糖浆，是现代经典组合。
脂肪洗过的基酒应尽快使用，保存时间不宜超过 2 周。
tipsEn: Bacon-fat-washed bourbon with maple syrup is a modern classic pairing.
Use fat-washed spirits within two weeks for the cleanest flavour.
warningsZh: 未完全冻结会让脂肪残留酒中导致口感油腻。
动物脂肪若存放不当易氧化变味。
warningsEn: Incomplete freezing leaves residual fat that coats the palate unpleasantly.
Animal fats oxidise quickly — work in small batches and keep refrigerated.

descriptionZh: 使用烟熏枪将木屑烟雾注入酒杯或摇酒壶，给鸡尾酒赋予独特的烟熏风味与视觉冲击。
descriptionEn: Using a smoking gun to fill a glass or shaker with wood-chip smoke, adding a fragrant smoky layer to the finished cocktail.
stepsZh: 准备好一支烟熏枪与少量木屑（苹果木、樱桃木或山核桃木）。
将装好鸡尾酒的酒杯或摇酒壶放在耐热表面上。
点燃烟熏枪的木屑，将烟雾通过软管注入酒杯。
立即用保鲜膜或杯盖封住杯口，让烟雾浸润 30-60 秒。
移除封盖，轻微搅动后即可饮用。
stepsEn: Prepare a smoking gun with a small amount of wood chips (apple, cherry or hickory).
Place the finished cocktail on a heat-safe surface.
Light the chips and pipe the smoke into the glass through the gun's hose.
Immediately cover the glass with cling film or a lid to trap the smoke for 30-60 seconds.
Uncover, give a brief stir, and serve.
tipsZh: 使用前将酒杯预冷，可让烟雾更持久地停留在液面。
木屑选择影响风味——苹果木甜润、山核桃木强烈。
tipsEn: Pre-chill the glass so the smoke lingers longer on the surface.
Chip choice shapes the flavour — applewood is sweet, hickory is bold.
warningsZh: 烟雾要在通风良好的环境下使用，避免室内积累。
过量烟熏会让酒液充满苦味。
warningsEn: Always smoke in a ventilated space; do not inhale concentrated smoke.
Over-smoking leaves an acrid, bitter note.

descriptionZh: 在酒杯边缘蘸上糖或盐的薄边，是 Margarita、Margarita-style 鸡尾酒的标志性装饰。
descriptionEn: Coating the rim of the glass with sugar or salt, the signature finish for Margaritas and many sours.
stepsZh: 将细海盐或粗糖倒在平底盘上，铺成薄薄一层。
取一片青柠或柠檬，沿杯口外侧轻擦一圈，让边缘湿润。
将湿润的杯口朝下，按入糖或盐盘中，轻轻旋转 30 度。
轻轻敲掉多余的糖/盐，杯内留出约 1-2 cm 的空边。
stepsEn: Spread a thin, even layer of fine salt or coarse sugar on a flat plate.
Run a lime or lemon wedge around the outer rim of the glass to moisten it.
Press the moistened rim into the salt or sugar and rotate 30 degrees.
Tap off any excess; leave a small clear band of rim on one side as a 'viewing window'.
tipsZh: 使用粗糖而非细砂糖，可获得更立体的视觉效果与口感。
先在杯口擦青柠/柠檬再蘸糖/盐，比直接用指头湿润更均匀。
tipsEn: Coarse sugar gives a more visible rim and a better crunch than fine sugar.
Wetting the rim with citrus rather than your fingers gives an even coat.
warningsZh: 糖边过厚会导致喝到最后咸甜失衡。
边缘湿润时不能有水滴落入杯内，否则会稀释酒液。
warningsEn: Too thick a rim overwhelms the drink by the last sip.
Don't let citrus drip into the glass — pre-moisten the rim only.

descriptionZh: 在搅拌型鸡尾酒表面挤压橙皮或柠檬皮，让精油喷洒在液面上并闻到香气，是 Martini、Manhattan 等的标准收尾。
descriptionEn: Pinching a citrus peel over the drink's surface to release its essential oils, the classic finish for stirred classics.
stepsZh: 取一片新鲜橙皮或柠檬皮（白色海绵层尽量少）。
将果皮朝下，拇指与食指捏住两端，弯曲皮面朝酒面。
在酒面正上方用力捏一下，让精油喷洒在液面上。
将果皮放入杯中或擦在杯口边缘作为装饰。
stepsEn: Cut a fresh citrus peel with as little pith as possible.
Hold the peel skin-side down over the surface of the drink.
Pinch sharply to express the oils onto the surface; you should see a visible mist.
Rub the peel along the rim and drop it in, or discard as the recipe dictates.
tipsZh: 白色海绵层（pith）过多会让果皮发苦——尽量削得薄一些。
喷香后再闻香，能更明显地感受到柑橘精油的层次。
tipsEn: Trim the pith as much as possible — it adds bitterness.
Always smell the drink after expressing the peel; the aromatics lead the palate.

descriptionZh: 用电动搅拌机短促搅拌 5-6 秒，让 tiki 与高糖鸡尾酒获得绵密泡沫与极冷降温。
descriptionEn: A 5-6 second buzz in a blender that chills and aerates tiki and high-sugar drinks, producing a thick, even foam.
stepsZh: 将所有原料加入搅拌机的玻璃罐。
加入 1 杯碎冰。
盖紧刀头，短促搅拌 5-6 秒至完全顺滑。
立即倒入预冷过的 tiki 或 highball 杯。
stepsEn: Combine all ingredients in the blender jar.
Add 1 cup of crushed ice.
Secure the blade assembly and pulse for 5-6 seconds until fully smooth.
Pour immediately into a chilled tiki or highball glass.
tipsZh: 搅拌时间超过 8 秒会让冰融化稀释过度。
事先预冷玻璃罐可减少冰融化。
tipsEn: Blending longer than 8 seconds over-dilutes the drink.
Pre-chill the blender jar to minimise melt.
warningsZh: 运转时务必盖紧刀头，避免液体喷溅。
硬质食材如冰块需分批投入，避免刀头卡死。
warningsEn: Always secure the lid before blending to avoid splatter.
Add hard ingredients in batches to prevent the blade from jamming.

descriptionZh: 用全脂牛奶与酸类（柠檬/青柠）凝固蛋白后滤清，得到清澈透亮、风味浓缩的液体，是现代酒吧的高级技法（Benjamin Franklin 配方）。
descriptionEn: Whole milk curdled with citrus/acid captures impurities, then filtered through coffee filters. Yields a crystal-clear, concentrated, long-keeping punch. A modern revival of an 18th-century technique.
stepsZh: 把所有酒、果汁、糖浆、糖混匀，确保酸度足够（通常需要 30ml+ 柠檬/青柠汁）
另取 250ml 全脂牛奶加热到接近沸腾
将酒液缓慢倒入热牛奶中（不要搅拌），蛋白会迅速絮凝并吸附浑浊物
静置 1-2 小时或冷藏过夜
用咖啡滤纸 + 细筛过滤 1-2 次，直到完全澄清
澄清液可冷藏保存 2 个月
stepsEn: Combine all spirits, juices, syrups, sugar — ensure enough acid (usually 30ml+ citrus).
In a separate vessel, heat 250ml whole milk to just below simmer.
Slowly pour the cocktail mix into the hot milk (do not stir). Casein will instantly curdle and trap impurities.
Rest 1-2 hours at room temp or overnight in the fridge.
Strain through coffee filters + fine mesh 1-2 times until crystal clear.
Keeps refrigerated up to 2 months.
tipsZh: 酸度不够就不凝固；牛奶要热的
第一次过滤可能需要 1-2 小时，别急
tipsEn: Not enough acid = no curdle. Milk must be hot.
First filter pass can take 1-2 hours. Don't rush it.
warningsZh: 对乳糖不耐受者不友好；可用琼脂做素食版澄清
warningsEn: Not suitable for lactose-intolerant drinkers. Agar-agar works as a vegan alternative.

descriptionZh: 用冷浸或低温慢煮（sous-vide）让基酒快速吸收草本/香料/水果风味——现代酒吧的核心预备技法之一。
descriptionEn: Cold steeping or sous-vide steeping of botanicals, spices, or fruit into base spirits. A cornerstone prep technique in modern craft bars.
stepsZh: 冷浸：把风味食材（草本/香料/果皮/茶）放入基酒，密封冷藏 4-72 小时
低温慢煮：把食材与基酒放入真空袋，60°C 水浴 1-2 小时（最快最浓）
双层滤纸过滤
装瓶冷藏可保存 2-4 周
stepsEn: Cold infusion: submerge botanicals in base spirit, seal, refrigerate 4-72 hours.
Sous-vide: vacuum-seal with spirit, 60°C water bath 1-2 hours (faster, more intense).
Double-filter through coffee filters.
Bottle and refrigerate. Keeps 2-4 weeks.
tipsZh: 草本用冷浸即可避免苦味；香料/坚果适合 sous-vide 提香
调酒师常备：茉莉花茶浸金酒、伯爵茶浸金酒、烟熏辣椒浸梅斯卡尔
tipsEn: Herbs: cold steep only (heat extracts bitter chlorophyll). Spices/nuts: sous-vide for max extraction.
Bar staples: jasmine-tea gin, earl-grey gin, smoked-chili mezcal.
warningsZh: sous-vide 温度不要超过 70°C，否则酒精大量挥发
warningsEn: Don't exceed 70°C in sous-vide — ethanol boils at ~78°C and you'll lose ABV.

descriptionZh: 低温烘干（90-100°C 烤箱 2-3 小时，或食品风干机）让水果片/草本变成脆片，给鸡尾酒增加质感与视觉。
descriptionEn: Slow oven or dehydrator drying of fruit wheels, citrus peels, or herbs. Modern bar garnish for texture and visual depth.
stepsZh: 水果（橙/柠檬/苹果/菠萝/西柚）切 3-5mm 薄片
烤盘铺烤纸，单层摆放
90-100°C 烤 2-3 小时，每 30 分钟翻面
完全冷却后变脆，可装密封罐保存 2 周
草本（迷迭香/百里香）60°C 30 分钟即可
stepsEn: Slice fruit (orange / lemon / apple / pineapple / grapefruit) 3-5mm thick.
Lay on parchment in a single layer.
Oven at 90-100°C for 2-3 hours, flip every 30 min.
Cool completely — they'll crisp up. Store airtight up to 2 weeks.
Herbs (rosemary / thyme): 60°C for 30 min is enough.
tipsZh: 火龙果/草莓/猕猴桃也很好看
挂在杯沿 + 旁边放一片，是 modern bar 的标志性呈现
tipsEn: Dragonfruit, strawberry, kiwi all dehydrate beautifully for color.
Hang one wheel on the rim + place another beside the glass — the classic modern bar plating.
warningsZh: 温度太高会焦，颜色会变深变苦
warningsEn: Too hot = burnt, bitter, dark color. Low and slow.
